LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_SuppressionModNotInsta: Open Suppression (Continued) mod page in browser. Use it to enable actual pawn suppression effects.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableSuppressionFireD: Show the suppression fire command for supported ranged weapons.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableExtendedBulletTr: Extend missed bullet trajectories beyond their normal weapon range.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableIndirectFireRaid: Make sure staging raids won't completely ignore being hit repeatedly by stray bullets. They might not react immediately but they will soon begin their attack if you continue hitting them with out-of-range indirect fire.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableSuppressionCompa: By default Suppression mod applies suppression effects around the bullet impact point. Since this mod shifts all missed bullet impacts far behind the target this option allows you to enable additional suppression of all targets along the bullet trajectory.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableSameFactionSuppr: Extended suppression effects added by this mod will affect not only hostile but also own faction of the shooter.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_SuppressionRadiusDesc: Maximum distance from a supported bullet trajectory at which suppression can be applied. Severity falls to zero at this distance.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableObstaclePenetrat: Allow bullets to continue through sufficiently weak Things after damaging them.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_PenetrationChanceDesc: Chance that a bullet hitting a penetrable Thing continues flying beyond it.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_AdjacentObstaclePenetr: Multiplier applied to penetration chance when another solid obstacle is found immediately behind the penetrated obstacle. Improves double walls efficiency.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_PenetrationContinuatio: Is applied to bullet trajectory length after penetration making sure it won't fly as far as it would otherwise.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableRicochetsDesc: Allow supported bullets to get deflected when they strike an obstacle at a shallow enough angles.
